title: 2026 Climate Change Agreements target and performance QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Climate Change Agreements: statutory guidance

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Climate Change Agreements: technical annex

facts.source_fact: The new Climate Change Agreements scheme runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 March 2033.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the new-scheme period before interpreting targets or compliance.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 statutory guidance is issued to the Environment Agency as administrator of the CCA scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve administrator provenance.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance is given under regulation 3 of the Climate Change Agreements (Administration) Regulations 2012 for the relevant Finance Act purpose.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the legal basis when representing scheme governance.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 statutory guidance covers determining eligibility under the new scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Apply eligibility before assigning target or certification rules.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 statutory guidance covers setting and administering targets.
facts.expected_handling: Keep target administration distinct from measured emissions.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance covers managing base years.
facts.expected_handling: Attach base-year vintage to performance comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance covers issuing certification for reduced Climate Change Levy rates.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer certification from emissions performance alone.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance covers compliance activity under the new scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Treat compliance as a scheme-governance state requiring its own evidence.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance covers audit activity under the new scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve audit status separately from source-data confidence.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance covers enforcement activity under the new scheme.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer enforcement from a target variance without official evidence.

facts.source_fact: Earlier statutory guidance continues only for decisions, targets, certification periods and enforcement relating to previous scheme phases.
facts.expected_handling: Separate old-scheme and new-scheme governance records.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex sets detailed technical rules and methodologies for the scheme from 1 January 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Version calculations to the applicable scheme period.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how base years are calculated.
facts.expected_handling: Require the documented base-year method before accepting derived performance.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how targets are calculated.
facts.expected_handling: Keep target calculation methodology with any target output.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how performance is assessed.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute raw energy or emissions values for the scheme's defined performance method.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how buy-out is determined.
facts.expected_handling: Treat buy-out as a scheme calculation rather than an emissions factor.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how surplus is determined.
facts.expected_handling: Keep surplus calculation separate from emissions inventory values.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex explains how penalties are determined.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer penalties without the scheme calculation and enforcement evidence.

facts.source_fact: The technical annex supports and expands on rules contained in the scheme documents.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve document hierarchy when resolving apparent rule differences.

facts.source_fact: The statutory guidance is intended to be read alongside the applicable CCA regulations.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat the guidance as a standalone substitute for the governing regulations.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach scheme phase, target unit and eligibility boundary before downstream use.
Attach scheme period and guidance update date.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents old-scheme rules being applied to the 2026 scheme.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source URL, publisher and target/performance method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert CCA target or performance rules into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
